title: Start Social Media Marketing for your Fitness Studio or Gym

facts.fact: The article was published on December 11, 2020.
The guide presents six steps for promoting a fitness business on social media.
facts.quote: How to start promoting your fitness business on social media in six simple steps

facts.fact: The author advises listing about 15-20 businesses or brands to research on social media before starting.
facts.quote: Start by making a list of about 15-20 businesses or brands that you hear a lot about.

facts.fact: The author recommends creating at least 5-10 posts in each content category in advance for busy days.
facts.quote: create at least 5-10 posts in each category in advance for days when you are too busy to generate fresh content.

facts.fact: Instagram and Facebook let businesses add a Book Now button to their profile.
facts.quote: Instagram and Facebook let you add a Book Now button to your profile.

facts.fact: Nike Women and Gold's Gym are named as examples of big fitness brands to study on social media.
facts.quote: You can start right at the top by checking out big fitness brands like Nike Women, Gold’s Gym, etc.

facts.fact: The article advises not starting with more than 2-3 social media posts a day, because a high posting volume early on can curb the reach of earlier posts when an account has few followers.
facts.quote: Although, don’t start with more than 2-3 posts a day. Initially, it might curb the reach of your previous posts since you won’t have a lot of followers.

facts.fact: The article says that even one lead per week from a lead generation mechanism on social media is better than nothing.
facts.quote: Even if you get as low as 1 lead every week, it’s still better than nothing.
